behavior_verified: Six recipe.json files are the sole authoring metadata; frozen profile.lock.json/checksums and upstream metadata are generated in snapshots without source writes.
Legacy external lock-only recipe directories remain readable; two competing declarations are rejected.
Default exports retain external file edits. Lite Agent-Reach-free and optional video-use variants remain available through scripts/recipes.py.
Reviewed vendored Agent-Reach source, patch, manifests, licenses and pinned upstream archives remain present; seven installer helpers consistently verify native Codex before replacing its link.
Independent package includes recipes, config, portable launchers, root notices and compiled SDK license, all covered by file hashes.
Package executes without examples, source ancestry, Python, Node, Go or Docker on PATH for metadata/export operations; absent recipes fail visibly.
Existing imported contexts stay frozen through external edits and service restart; metadata reads/exports do not create tasks, sessions or Docker builds.
migration_notes: Use the new version directory or a fresh staged package with the existing --data path. Overlaying old lock files beside recipe.json creates a deliberately rejected ambiguity.
Old python examples/<profile>/run.py commands are replaced by scripts/recipes.py; no compatibility examples directory or symlinks remain.
Historical logs retain their original paths and bytes as evidence, not current executable references.
This release does not change image-build data directory organization or add runtime global observation settings.
limits: No actual Docker image build, live model/provider authentication, GPU, vLLM, VideoApp or production Kun worker execution.
Windows was cross-compiled and its package layout tested using executable-header fixtures; it was not run on Windows.
OpenMontage native bridge test was moved and parsed, but its separate exact upstream checkout was unavailable, so that native integration was not rerun.
Agent-Reach wheel building was not rerun because hatchling was unavailable; vendored source hashes, fixed local install paths and removal of duplicate force-include were checked.
No new browser workflow was run; this release changes directory/runtime resource loading rather than UI behavior.
